note: Per-arm search limits for the corr-cert campaign. Money, request, token, reasoning and timeout caps live only in broker-config.json and are read at run time (model client timeout = broker timeout + 30 s). The development m-set path and SHA-256 are read at run time from frozen_manifest (files['development.json'], next to the manifest); holdout is never loaded. Both configs, the prompts, the seed, the frozen hashes and first-prompt.sha256 are covered by the approval hash (python -m integrations.corr_backends approval-hash). Unlike the lift campaign, evaluating a candidate here is a single cheap pass over m=4..12 (well under a second, see TASK.md), so there is no staged screen/full split and no development-archive database (omitted; see TASK.md 'Evaluation cost note').
evaluation: single pass: every candidate is scored once on the full frozen development set (m=4..12, 9 evaluations of coefficients(m) each), no screening stage
max_requests_note: Rerun (user-approved step 4, reduced size, 2026-09-25): iterations and per-arm sub-caps (35/35/30/26, sum 126) reduced from attempt 2's 60/60/50/40 and 42/42/35/28 to fit broker-config.json's new max_usd 21.0 pool (floor(21/0.1666368)=126). Each arm still gets its own ledger file (broker-ledger-corr-v2.<engine>.json) capped at min(its max_requests, what the shared pool has left after earlier arms' ledgers); the launcher refuses to start an arm whose sub-cap is 0 or whose remaining share of the shared pool is 0 (autoresearch/TRACE-AUDIT-260925.md defect 2). Attempts 1 (broker-ledger-corr.json, 4k max_tokens) and 2 (broker-ledger-corr-8k.json, 8k max_tokens, 147-request shared pool) remain on disk as evidence and are not reused by this rerun.
order_note: Mirrors the lift-m9-260924 campaign order: GEPA and sequential control first, matched iteration counts; AdaEvolve and EvoX start only after GEPA shows one productive cycle (valid proposal, selection, second proposal responding to feedback), per PROTOCOL.md's kill conditions and budget ceiling ($25, one day timebox).
